conventions.points_local_m: ORIGINAL measurements in the sensor frame, never transformed: +X = LiDAR front, +Y = LiDAR left
conventions.pose: sensor position (x_m, y_m) in the global map frame and heading theta_deg, counter-clockwise from the global +X axis
conventions.global_point: x_g = x_m + x*cos(theta) - y*sin(theta); y_g = y_m + x*sin(theta) + y*cos(theta)
conventions.aligned: true once an automatic alignment was accepted; alignment_quality holds the measurements that justified it
conventions.reference: the first scan in the list is the fixed map reference
conventions.scan_ids: unique numbers, never reused after a deletion; next_scan_id is the number of the next new scan
conventions.source: LD06 Teleplot XY (mm) from ld06.printScanTeleplot(), converted to metres with the library's Y axis flipped
